title: WMAttack: Automated Attack Search for Adversarial Evaluation of World-Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.23220v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite the growing use of world models as decision-making agents, their adversarial robustness remains underexplored due to the lack of dedicated automated evaluation methods. A key obstacle is that attack evaluation must be both accurate and efficient: weak manually tuned attacks can overestimate robustness, while exhaustive hyperparameter search is prohibitively expensive because each candidate requires closed-loop rollouts through learned latent dynamics. We introduce WMAttack, an automated attack-search framework for adversarial evaluation of world-model agents. WMAttack formulates robustness evaluation as a finite-budget search over attack configurations, including attack families, perturbation budgets, optimization steps, restarts, and allocation rules. translated_title: WMAttack：面向世界模型智能体对抗性评估的自动化攻击搜索
translated_abstract: 尽管世界模型作为决策智能体的应用日益增多，但由于缺乏专门的自动化评估方法，其对抗鲁棒性仍未得到充分研究。一个关键障碍在于攻击评估必须同时兼顾准确性与效率：较弱的手动调参攻击可能高估鲁棒性，而穷举式的超参数搜索代价过于高昂，因为每个候选方案都需要通过学习到的潜在动力学进行闭环推演。我们提出了 WMAttack，一个用于世界模型智能体对抗性评估的自动化攻击搜索框架。WMAttack 将鲁棒性评估表述为在攻击配置空间（包括攻击族、扰动预算、优化步数、重启次数和分配规则）上的有限预算搜索问题。为提高搜索准确性，自校正攻击搜索（SCAS）利用奖励退化、动作不稳定性以及运行时开销等反馈信号来不断修正攻击提议分布。
tldr: WMAttack提出了一个自动化攻击搜索框架，通过自校正攻击搜索（SCAS）利用多种反馈信号在有限预算内高效且准确地评估世界模型智能体的对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: WMAttack presents an automated attack-search framework that leverages Self-Correcting Attack Search (SCAS) with multi-signal feedback to efficiently and accurately evaluate the adversarial robustness of world-model agents under finite budgets.
